claims.text: llm.complete has no prompt in code: every brief, the answer shape, the summary check and citation numbering are configuration on generic steps

The three code briefs (llm.py:156-194 NEWSPAPER_BRIEF, TRANSCRIPT_BRIEF, RECORDING_BRIEF, _BRIEFS) leave the code: llm.complete resolves every `brief` name only from the bound actor's params.briefs (admin-only via check_actor_briefs), with no code default (today an absent brief means newspaper, llm.py:343-344)

Every llm.complete step names its brief: the committed daily-newspaper summary step (docs/rules/newspaper/workflows/daily-newspaper.json:600-670, no brief today) gains brief newspaper; transcript-to-reader keeps brief transcript; the bundle actor docs/rules/newspaper/actors/cortex-spark2.json gains params.briefs for both with today's exact text

The recording answer becomes step configuration: a generic `answer` option checks the reply's JSON shape from config (field names, types such as text-lines, word, list of strings, item and character limits, a pattern) instead of recording_answer.py's fixed {summary, word, facts, action_items} validator (MAX_ITEMS 30, MAX_ITEM_CHARS 300, word ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z-]{1,23}$)

The answer cache works for any brief by step config; existing files answer.recording.<sha16>.json with doc brief 'recording' and schema 1 stay readable (the cache name and label default to today's values), so recordings are not re-asked and checklist ids stay stable

newspaper.render no longer enforces the summary shape in code: _summary_ok (newspaper_render.py:218-229) is removed from render, which shows any summary it is given (summary_to_xhtml already renders paragraphs and links); the shape and allowed-links rule moves to a generic validation step whose rules (allowed links from a given list and field, line shape) are step config

revisions.text: newspaper.render no longer enforces the summary shape in code: _summary_ok (newspaper_render.py:218-229: every non-blank line a bullet carrying a link to one of the section's results) becomes configuration or a separate generic validation step; render shows any summary it is given (summary_to_xhtml already renders paragraphs and links)

claims.text: A new generic step numbers a list into text for a model's input ([1] then the configured fields of each item, format in config); today no builtin or {{ }} template can loop over a list (refs.py _text renders a list as str(list))

A new generic replace step rewrites each [n] reference in a text using the nth item of a given list and an output template from step config (for example [{n}]({url})); the step is a basic text operation with no format of its own, and a reference outside the list is reported, never invented

revisions.text: A new generic step replaces each [n] reference in a text with a configured field (for example url, as a markdown link) of the nth item of a list; a reference outside the list is reported, never invented
revisions.reason: operator 2026-11-02: replaced with [n](url), but as a configured replace-string step, not hardcoded

claims.text: Rollout order: the live actors get params.briefs (admin `actors update`) before the new code is enabled, because rollout import does not touch actors (cli/_commands/rollout.py:725-735) and rollout seed covers variables only; the live recording flow (configured live, docs/operations/library-items.md:22,57) must name its brief and answer option before enable
transcript.render keeps reading the parsed answer it is given; its own lenient parser (transcript_render.py:177-227) is not removed in this work
Code holds only basic units and operations (number a list, replace references, validate a shape, render); every prompt, format, template and shape rule is step or actor configuration
